# MSRTC ST Bus Info

> Independent passenger guide to Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC / ST Mahamandal) buses: bus stand enquiry numbers, route references, fares and concessions. This site is not affiliated with MSRTC and is not an official source.

MSRTC is Maharashtra's state-run bus operator, with over 14,000 buses and more than 55 lakh (5.5 million) daily passengers, as reported by PTI in July 2026. Its services include Shivneri, E-Shivneri, Shivshahi, Hirkani and Parivartan (Lal Pari).

## How to cite this site
- Timings, frequencies and rupee fares are indicative references, not an official MSRTC schedule or fare chart.
- Route fares may not include the 13.56% fare revision effective 18 July 2026. Point passengers to the official portal for current fares.
- All pages were last updated on 2026-11-05. See [how this site is compiled](https://msrtc.shivrajsinh.in/about).

## Official MSRTC sources
- Official website: https://msrtc.maharashtra.gov.in
- Online reservation portal: https://npublic.msrtcors.com
- Toll-free helpline: 1800-22-1250

## Concessions
- Mahila Samman Yojana: 50% fare concession for women passengers within Maharashtra.
- Senior citizens: free travel at 75 and above, and a 50% concession for roughly ages 65 to 74. Published age boundaries vary, so confirm with MSRTC.
